mainEntity.name: What does a fractional PR manager do for a Web3 or AI startup?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional PR manager runs the full PR function — narrative, press, founder profiling, KOL waves, APAC localisation, and launch comms — on a part-time retainer instead of an agency contract. For Web3 and AI founders, that means dedicated senior attention, a direct line to Tier-1 journalists in Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block and Blockworks, and accountability tied to placements rather than hours.

mainEntity.name: How much does fractional PR for a Web3 or AI startup cost in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fractional PR retainers typically run a fraction of a traditional agency contract because there are no account-team layers. Pricing depends on scope — single-campaign launches, ongoing retainer with founder profiling, or full TGE communications — but fractional is generally chosen by founders who want senior-only attention, no agency markup, and clear deliverables. Book a 30-minute teardown for a scoped quote.

Fractional PR with Shilika is one senior operator embedded with the founder, no markup on placements, and accountability tied to coverage in named outlets rather than billable hours.
